## Requirements

(from contract §In scope — deliverables:)

1. `LICENSE-MIT` + `LICENSE-APACHE` (standard texts; copyright line
   naming the operator as repo owner); workspace + every crate/plugin
   manifest `license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"` (scripted;
   `cargo metadata` shows no crate without it).
2. `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` — `ring` (ISC/OpenSSL-derived terms), the
   rustls graph, `webpki-roots` (MPL-2.0 data — stated), `tempfile`
   dev-dep; generated from `Cargo.lock` by a committed script so it
   cannot drift.
3. `SECURITY.md` (supported versions, private reporting via GitHub
   advisories, response targets), `CONTRIBUTING.md` (build/test
   commands, build-memory workflow, DCO-or-not stated, dual-license
   contribution clause), `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` (Contributor Covenant
   2.1), `CHANGELOG.md` (Keep-a-Changelog; `0.1.0` unreleased).
4. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/{bug_report,feature_request}.yml` +
   `config.yml`, `.github/pull_request_template.md`, `CODEOWNERS`.
5. Living-doc scrub — personal paths replaced by repo-relative or
   `<skills>`-style placeholders in the living set only;
   `scripts/check-living-docs.sh` (CI step) fails if a living doc
   reintroduces `/Users/`.
6. README "About the build record" section — what `docs/build/`,
   `research/`, `docs/tickets/` are and why they keep provenance paths.

Plus the amended CI-mode ruling (2026-10-20, ADR-0362): new steps that
read `docs/`/`research/` content carry `# ci-mode: both — <reason>`
(check-living-docs); non-docs readers carry the `!= 'fast'` gate
(cargo-metadata licence check); a `both` step never depends on a gated
step.

## Plan

Phase-0 facts established (Load list only):

- Workspace `[workspace.package]` carries `license = "Apache-2.0"`
  (Cargo.toml:516); all 51 members inherit via `license.workspace =
  true`; only `crates/hh-lab` lacks the field (literal
  `version`/`edition`, no license line). Plugins' package manifests
  live under `crates/`; `plugins/*/plugin.manifest.json` are plugin
  ABI manifests, not Cargo manifests. Three spike manifests (own
  `[workspace]` roots, `publish = false`) also get the line.
- Living-set scan (ticket's own enumeration + full `/Users/`/`/home/`
  sweep outside provenance) is already clean — zero violations in
  human-facing files; the one `/home/` hit is a synthetic test fixture
  (`crates/hh-secrets/tests/acceptance.rs:289`, code, out of the
  ruling's scope). The scrub deliverable is therefore the guard +
  README section, not edits.
- `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --offline` works (0.2 s) and
  reports real license expressions for all 36 non-workspace packages:
  `ring` = `Apache-2.0 AND ISC` (OpenSSL-derived terms per upstream),
  `rustls` = `Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT`, `rustls-webpki`/`untrusted` =
  ISC, `webpki-roots` = CDLA-Permissive-2.0 (Mozilla root data is
  MPL-2.0 — stated per the ticket), `tempfile` = MIT OR Apache-2.0,
  `subtle` = BSD-3-Clause, r-efi carries an `LGPL-2.1-or-later` option,
  the rest MIT/Apache-family.
- CI: `check-ci-gating.sh` enforces the step-mode convention on steps
  after `id: path`; scripts invoked from gated steps are readers-scanned
  for `docs/`/`research/` refs — the licensing scripts must stay free
  of those tokens (comments included).
- Repo slug `SteveVitali/MetaHarness` → CODEOWNERS `* @SteveVitali`;
  copyright line `Steve Vitali` (git author identity).

Implementation order:

1. LICENSE-MIT + LICENSE-APACHE (standard texts, `Copyright (c) 2026
   Steve Vitali`); workspace license flip; `hh-lab` +
   three spike manifests gain the license line (mechanical edit).
2. `scripts/gen-third-party-notices.sh` — Cargo.lock-driven package set
   + `cargo metadata` license expressions + curated notice table
   (unknown package → loud failure); emits THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md;
   `--check` = regenerate-to-temp + diff.
3. `scripts/check-licenses.sh` — `cargo metadata --format-version 1` +
   python3 assert every workspace package license is exactly
   `MIT OR Apache-2.0`.
4. `scripts/check-living-docs.sh` — living-set scan (tracked files
   minus `docs/build|tickets|adr/`, `research/`, code extensions, the
   script itself) for `/Users/<x>`/`/home/<x>` minus documented
   placeholder spellings; + `scripts/ci/test-check-living-docs.sh`
   fixture self-test in the CI self-test step.
5. SECURITY.md / CONTRIBUTING.md / CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md (Covenant 2.1) /
   CHANGELOG.md (Keep-a-Changelog, `[0.1.0] — unreleased`).
6. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/{bug_report,feature_request}.yml` +
   `config.yml`, `.github/pull_request_template.md`, `CODEOWNERS`.
7. README "About the build record" + License section.
8. ci.yml: living-docs guard (`# ci-mode: both`, placed before
   `id: path` so it can never sit behind the gate) + gated
   `License metadata + third-party notices` step after `cargo fetch`.
9. Verify: fmt, metadata license check, notices `--check`, living-docs
   guard + grep proof, ci-gating + its self-test, check-build-memory,
   gitleaks staged.
